feats.title: Mighty Battlerage
feats.description: The damage bonus granted by your Battlerager Vigor increases by 1. At 21st level, it increases by 2.

feats.title: Grit
feats.description: When you spend a healing surge to regain hit points, you also gain temporary hit points equal to your Constitution.

feats.title: Chainmail Agility
feats.description: You ignore the speed penalty normally incurred by wearing chainmail.

feats.title: Fey Charge
feats.description: When you charge, you can expend your fey step racial power as a free action to replace up to 5 squares of your charge movement with teleportation. If the charge attack hits, you do not expend fey step.

feats.title: Dizzying Mace
feats.description: When you hit an enemy with a power that dazes the target while you are using a mace, the target also takes a penalty to attack rolls equal to your Constitution for as long as it remains dazed by your attack.

feats.title: Plunging Blade
feats.description: When you make an opportunity attack with a light blade, you score a critical hit on a natural roll of 19 or 20.

feats.title: Reckless Attacker
feats.description: The first time you score a critical hit with a fighter attack power on your turn, you can make a melee basic attack as a free action. If you do so, you take a –2 penalty to AC until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Reliable Persistence
feats.description: When you miss a creature with a martial power that has the reliable keyword, you gain a +4 bonus to attack rolls against that creature using that power. This bonus lasts until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Striking Resurgence
feats.description: When you use second wind as a standard action, you can forgo the bonus to defenses to make a melee basic attack as a free action.

feats.title: Ubiquitous Shield
feats.description: While you are using a shield, enemies gain no bonus to attack rolls for having combat advantage against you.

feats.title: Phalanx Warrior
feats.description: When you are using a shield, adjacent allies gain a +1 shield bonus to AC.

feats.title: Daunting Challenge
feats.description: Creatures marked by you take a –3 penalty to attack rolls for any attack that doesn't include you as a target (rather than a –2 penalty).

feats.title: Marked Scourge
feats.description: Once per round, you can add your Wisdom to your damage roll against an enemy marked by you.

feats.title: Staggering Challenge
feats.description: When you hit an enemy with a melee basic attack granted by Combat Challenge while you are using a shield, you can knock the target prone instead of dealing damage with the attack.

feats.title: Tactical Superiority
feats.description: Whenever you hit an enemy marked by you with an opportunity attack, that enemy is slowed until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Mastered Technique
feats.requirements: 11th level, One-Handed Weapon Talent or Two-Handed Weapon Talent
feats.description: You gain a +1 feat bonus to AC when you hit with an attack using a weapon of the style covered by your One-Handed Weapon Talent or Two-Handed Weapon Talent class feature until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Pinning Challenge
feats.requirements: 11th level, One-Handed Weapon Talent or Two-Handed Weapon Talent
feats.description: Whenever you hit a target already marked by you with a two-handed weapon and when using a basic attack, the target is also immobilized until the start of your next turn.

feats.title: Steely Defense
feats.requirements: 11th level, One-Handed Weapon Talent or Two-Handed Weapon Talent
feats.description: When you take the total defense action while wielding a two-handed weapon, any enemy that attacks you with a melee attack takes damage equal to your Strength.

feats.title: Combat Opening
feats.description: When you can make a melee basic attack against a target because of Combat Challenge, you can instead choose to let an ally make a melee basic attack against that target as a free action.
